environment_proposal.package_lock: UNRESOLVED; validate official CUDA torch/torchvision and pinned TerraTorch dependency compatibility first

input_contract.grid: 32x32 at30m; no spatial resampling or invented spectral channels
input_contract.mask: all five raw channels valid in both dates; exclude incomplete16x16 tokens for BOTH systems; labels0/1 only
models: frozen TerraMind1.0-tiny with S2L2A BLUE/GREEN/RED and S1GRD VV/VH
input_contract.normalization: fixed publisher constants once; no TRAIN/VAL fitting
input_contract.target: retrospective pseudo-label agreement; not independently verified mining
input_contract.temporal: paired shared encoder; absolute feature difference, temporally symmetric

terramind.head: small trainable segmentation head; feature API/layout MUST pass smoke first

smoke_proposal.forward_backward: synthetic only; frozen backbone,no optimizer update; strict checkpoint hash before load
stop: wrong band mapping or double normalization

source.normalization: S2L2A selected BLUE/GREEN/RED entries, SR*10000; S1GRD dB; fixed constants applied once to BOTH models

training_proposal.augmentation: NONE in initial paired pilot; no hidden feature transforms
training_proposal.early_stopping: same VAL masked loss,patience2; TEST sealed
training_proposal.precision: FP32 initial; no silent AMP fallback
training_proposal.sampling: All common-mask-usable TRAIN patches in seed-shuffled order; equal4 original crops/group; empty-supervision batches skipped and counted; no VAL sampling
training_proposal.threshold_selection: VAL only: max IoU-0.25*FPR; ties lowerFPR,nearest0.50; also report fixed0.50
training_proposal.uncertainty: per-group counts/FPR,positive-group support,matched completed-seed mean/sampleSD; no pixel-independence significance
